items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: The only older one was Arcelon Perez... and Poligemo the bass player.

ctx.x: I see. You were all young kids then, right?

Yeah. The only thing - the only older one was Arcelon Perez, that he lives in Mexico now, and Poligemo the bass player. The rest, Miguelito Valdes the violin --, he was about his early twanties, the rest was a bunch of young guys.
Okay. How many numbers did you have in your repertoire, in your book?
